claims.head: Something has to give
claims.body: The Avalanche are one of the league’s best for shot volume, but the Devils are one of the best at keeping shots away. Hot take: the Avalanche break through anyway.

claims.body: The Devils are near the top of the league for the power play, but the Avalanche are one of the best at the penalty kill. Our lean: the Devils’ power play wins out. Power plays usually beat kills in these spots.

claims.head: Kovacevic and Chisholm get the Schwartz assignment
claims.call: The Devils’ P3 (Kovacevic and Chisholm) spends at least 36% of its 5-on-5 time against the Avalanche’s third line.
claims.body: At home, the Devils keep sending Kovacevic and Chisholm out against opponents’ third lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Sheldon Keefe has been picking a defense pair for opponents’ third lines. Tonight the Avalanche’s third line is Schwartz, Svechkov and Hughes.

claims.gist: At home, Sheldon Keefe likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Avalanche’s third line.

claims.body: The Avalanche played last night and get no rest before this one. Teams in that spot usually get the worse of the chances, so we expect the Devils to control more of the play than they usually do.

notes.text: They dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen in 4 of their last 8 games, including the last one. Nazem Kadri takes shifts on two lines, L2 and L4. Noah Juulsen is the seventh defenseman, rotating in mostly beside Manson and Malinski.
T.J. Hughes is day to day, reported after he played in their last game.
Gavin Brindley was added to the roster on Oct 15 and has played beside Parker Kelly and Fedor Svechkov.
Zachary L'Heureux is no longer killing penalties: 3% of the team’s shorthanded time in 3 games, down from 36% with his old team last season.
Luke Evangelista is out (illness) and has missed the last 3 games. He is a top-six forward. Dawson Mercer has taken his spot beside Timo Meier and Nico Hischier.
Connor Brown is out and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward. Arseny Gritsyuk has taken his spot beside Jesper Bratt and Jack Hughes.
Johnathan Kovacevic was added to the roster on Oct 11 and has played beside Declan Chisholm.

NJD.head: Leaning the Devils’ way
NJD.body: Even though New Jersey has home-ice advantage, the Devils will be without Evangelista, and Colorado has been out-chancing opponents lately. Still, it’s close: the Avalanche can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.

COL.head: The Avalanche start a half-step behind
COL.body: Even though New Jersey has home-ice advantage, the Devils will be without Evangelista, and Colorado has been out-chancing opponents lately. The Avalanche can tip it if they keep dangerous shots away.

story.head: Something has to give
paras: The Avalanche come in at 5-2-1, the Devils at 4-4-0.

It’s strength against strength: the Avalanche are one of the league’s best for shot volume, but the Devils are one of the best at keeping shots away. At home, Sheldon Keefe likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Avs’ third line.

items.text: The Avalanche are newly without T.J. Hughes.
The Devils are newly without Luke Evangelista, and have had to make do without Connor Brown all season.
Brock Nelson has six goals in eight games against New Jersey since 2023-24, most of them with the Islanders.
Jack Hughes has scored in three straight games against Colorado.
